mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. This relationship holds consistently across historical monetary policy cycles without additional conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS is below 4.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5%, it signals aggressive monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates and reduces valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 45% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or the Rank IC over 2-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in employment (PAYEMS) and decline in unemployment (UNRATE) signals labor market tightening that accelerates inflation and triggers future rate hikes, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where PAYEMS rises and UNRATE falls, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During a housing market boom (HOUST > 2100), strong residential construction supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where HOUST > 2100, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A lower unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a tight labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days without additional conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE < 5.0%, or the Rank IC over 2-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly inflation rate exceeding 0.3% (CPIAUCSL MoM change > 0.3%) signals accelerating price pressures that prompt Federal Reserve rate hikes, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 45% of instances where CPIAUCSL MoM change > 0.3%, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in housing starts (HOUST) and GDP growth (GDPC1) indicates robust economic expansion that supports corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where HOUST and GDPC1 both rise, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of strong industrial production growth (INDPRO MoM growth > 0.5%), manufacturing expansion boosts corporate profits and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO MoM growth > 0.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.
